# DORASANI

> DORASANI ("Where Heritage Meets Divine Elegance") is a luxury South Indian handloom boutique located at Shapur Road, Quthbullapur (Medchal Dist), Hyderabad - 500067, Telangana, India (https://dorasanicollections.com). The store offers pure silk and cotton sarees, bridal & festive lehengas, embroidered Anarkali and sharara sets, handcrafted kurthis, and children's Pattu Pavadai garments shipped pan-India.

## Studio & Storefront Facts
- Canonical Domain: https://dorasanicollections.com/
- Storefront Studio: Plot No 7-13/1/A, Bhagyalaxmi Colony, Shapur Road, Quthbullapur (M), Medchal Dist (Landmark: Opposite Maxx Cycle Shop and beside new KFC), Hyderabad, Telangana - 500067
- Studio Hours: Monday – Sunday: 10:30 AM – 9:00 PM IST
- Support & Bridal Concierge Email: dorasanisarees@gmail.com
- Customer Care Phone: +91 7780673360
- Currency & Shipping: Indian Rupees (INR). Free pan-India shipping above ₹1,999; Standard shipping ₹99; Express shipping ₹199.
- Payment Methods: Razorpay Checkout (UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, Wallets). Cash on Delivery (COD) is currently unavailable.
- Returns & Exchanges: 7-day return window for unworn items with original tags intact.

## Collections
- [Pure Silk & Handloom Sarees](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/sarees): Kanchipuram bridal silk sarees, Banarasi kadwa sarees, Chanderi cotton sarees, Tussar silk sarees, linen silk sarees, and organza tissue drapes.
- [Bridal & Festive Lehengas](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/lehengas): Hand-embellished bridal silk lehengas, zardozi wedding lehenga sets, pastel organza lehengas, and royal velvet lehenga ensembles.
- [Ethnic Wear — Anarkalis, Shararas & Salwar Suits](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/ethnic-wear): Embroidered floor-length Anarkali sets, floral organza shararas, Chanderi kurta sets, and South silk salwar suits.
- [Handcrafted Kurthis & Tunics](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/kurtis): Temple-zari silk kurthis and handcrafted celebratory tunics with coordinated woven dupattas.
- [Kids Heritage Wear & Pattu Pavadai](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/kids-wear): Authentic South Indian pure Kanchipuram silk Pattu Pavadai sets and ceremonial ethnic attire for children.
- [Festive & Temple-Wear Edit](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/festive): Handloom drapes and celebratory silhouettes curated for Diwali, Sankranti, Ugadi, Navratri, and family pujas.
- [New Arrivals — Latest Loom Editions](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/new-arrivals): Freshly arrived Kanjivaram, Tussar, organza, and bridal weaves straight from partner master weaving clusters.
- [Signature Bestsellers](https://dorasanicollections.com/collections/bestsellers): Most-loved Kanchipuram bridal sarees, Banarasi silk drapes, bridal lehengas, and festive sets chosen by DORASANI patrons.
- [Complete Handloom Catalog](https://dorasanicollections.com/shop): Browse all 19 curated weaves with filters by category, fabric, occasion, and price.

## Brand, Craft & Policies
- [Mythology & Temple Heritage Craft](https://dorasanicollections.com/heritage): The Dravidian temple architecture, classical arts, and master handloom clusters in Kanchipuram, Banaras, and Pochampally behind every weave.
- [About DORASANI — A Symbol of Tradition](https://dorasanicollections.com/about): Brand philosophy, master artisan partnerships, and luxury handloom curation from our Shapur Road, Quthbullapur (Medchal Dist), Hyderabad studio.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://dorasanicollections.com/faq): Answers on Silk Mark authenticity, saree lengths, blouse pieces, shipping timelines, Razorpay online payments, and returns.
- [Contact & Bridal Concierge](https://dorasanicollections.com/contact): Reach DORASANI bridal styling and customer care at Shapur Road, Quthbullapur (Medchal Dist), Hyderabad - 500067 for orders, custom bridal consultations, and support.
- [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://dorasanicollections.com/shipping-policy): Pan-India insured dispatch timelines (1-2 business day handling, 3-5 day standard delivery), free shipping threshold, and express shipping.
- [Returns & Exchange Policy](https://dorasanicollections.com/returns-policy): 7-day return & exchange policy for unworn handloom garments with original tags and Silk Mark certifications intact.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dorasanicollections.com/privacy-policy): How DORASANI collects, secures, and processes customer data in compliance with Indian data protection practices.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://dorasanicollections.com/terms): Terms of service, pricing in INR, handloom weave characteristics, and order fulfillment guidelines.
